cases.name: spec-example-a

cases.name: spec-example-area
cases.about: 6.4: explicit registry equal to G(tltc), unquoted, uppercase markup, empty tail

cases.name: spec-example-meta
cases.about: 6.4: meta refresh; URL= and a quote, cut at the closing quote

cases.name: spec-example-form
cases.about: 6.4: a publication address goes to /unavailable with pct(C)

cases.name: spec-untouched-scheme-case
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-host-case
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-port
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-character-reference
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-scheme-relative
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-img-src
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-script
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-comment
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: spec-untouched-textarea
cases.about: 6.4: listed as untouched

cases.name: slot-whitespace-kept
cases.about: 6.2: leading and trailing ASCII whitespace of a slot is kept and excluded from C

cases.name: slot-whitespace-untouched
cases.about: 6.2: whitespace inside C, or a vertical tab (not ASCII whitespace), leaves the slot untouched

cases.name: tail-rejected-bytes
cases.about: 6.2: a tail T with a byte <= 0x20, 0x7F or a backslash leaves the slot untouched

cases.name: tail-allowed-bytes
cases.about: 6.2 and 6.3: every other tail byte (quotes, angle brackets, %, bytes >= 0x80) is copied as is

cases.name: pct-encoding
cases.about: 6.3: pct keeps A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~ and writes every other byte as % and two uppercase hex digits

cases.name: short-names
cases.about: 6.3: short name.s maps to S://name.s.D followed by T' (a / is added when T is empty or starts with ? or #)

cases.name: short-names-any-suffix
cases.about: 6.3: a short name maps to its name host whether or not G(s) exists

cases.name: explicit-registry
cases.about: 6.3: explicit g.name.s maps to the name host iff g = G(s), otherwise to /unavailable

cases.name: publication-addresses
cases.about: 6.3: a publication address r.s always maps to /unavailable

cases.name: non-canonical-addresses
cases.about: 6.2: an address that is not canonical per BROWSER_CONTRACT 4, or not urma://, is left untouched

cases.name: local-parameters
cases.about: 6: D = localhost:<port> uses S = http

cases.name: attribute-syntax
cases.about: 6.1: quoted, unquoted and spaced values, missing whitespace, slashes and FF as separators

cases.name: attribute-first-wins
cases.about: 6.1: only the first attribute of a name counts; the tokenizer drops later duplicates

cases.name: attribute-names
cases.about: 6.1: attribute names run to whitespace, /, > or = and compare after ASCII lowercasing only

cases.name: slot-elements
cases.about: 6.2: the slots are a and area href, form action and meta refresh content; namespaces are ignored

cases.name: meta-refresh-forms
cases.about: 6.2: the URL of the shared declarative refresh steps over the raw content bytes

cases.name: meta-refresh-no-slot
cases.about: 6.2: no slot when the refresh steps end before a URL, and no match for a non-canonical URL

cases.name: rcdata
cases.about: 6.1: title and textarea switch to RCDATA until the appropriate end tag, end-tag attributes included

cases.name: rawtext
cases.about: 6.1: style, xmp, iframe, noembed and noframes switch to RAWTEXT; noscript does not switch

cases.name: plaintext
cases.about: 6.1: plaintext switches to PLAINTEXT, which never ends

cases.name: script-data
cases.about: 6.1: script switches to script data until </script>, whatever the namespace or self-closing flag

cases.name: script-escaped
cases.about: 6.1: the script data escaped and double escaped states

cases.name: comments
cases.about: 6.1: comments end at -->, --!>, or right after <!-- and <!---; the less-than sign states change nothing

cases.name: bogus-comments-and-doctype
cases.about: 6.1: DOCTYPE, <?, <!x, </ followed by a non-letter and <![CDATA[ all end at the next >

cases.name: svg-cdata-is-bogus-comment
cases.about: 6.1: <![CDATA[ starts a bogus comment even inside svg, ending at the first >

cases.name: markup-edges
cases.about: 6.1: < needs an ASCII letter to open a tag; a tag name runs to whitespace, / or >

cases.name: eof-in-tag
cases.about: 6.1: a start tag cut by the end of the input is never emitted

cases.name: eof-in-attribute-value
cases.about: 6.1: an attribute value left open at the end of the input drops its tag

cases.name: latin1-document
cases.about: 6.1: bytes >= 0x80 are ordinary characters, copied in T and pct-encoded byte by byte

cases.name: invalid-utf8-document
cases.about: 6.1: no decoding and no sniffing; a UTF-16 byte order mark before ASCII markup changes nothing

cases.name: utf8-bom-document
cases.about: 6.1: a UTF-8 byte order mark is three ordinary characters

cases.name: utf16le-document
cases.about: 6.1: a UTF-16 document stays unchanged

cases.name: utf16be-document
cases.about: 6.1: a UTF-16 document stays unchanged

cases.name: carriage-returns
cases.about: 6.1: CR is treated as LF; a CR inside C stops the match

cases.name: page-mixed
cases.about: 6.3: a whole page; only matched candidates change, in document order

cases.name: page-without-links
cases.about: 6.3: a page without urma:// slots is served unchanged
